name: buchstabenzeit-android
description: Capacitor Android shell for the Buchstabenzeit offline reading app. Wraps the shared web source in sites/lesen/static as bundled, offline-first assets. The website deploys separately from static/ and is unaffected by this project.

scripts.sync: npm run copy-assets && cap sync android
scripts.build:debug: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.install:debug: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew installDebug
scripts.build:release: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
